description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一。大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII 字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique among different requests. It is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
数仓版集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the cluster IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the destination region.
The name of the resource group.

description.zh: 需要绑定的数据库账号。既可以绑定数据库普通账号，也可以绑定数据库高权限账号。
description.en: The database account to attach. You can attach either a standard account or a privileged account.

title.zh: 将资源组与数据库用户进行绑定

descriptions.zh:
### 注意事项
- 该接口仅适用于32核及以上规格的弹性模式集群版（新版）集群。
- 默认资源组USER_DEFAULT不支持绑定数据库账号。
descriptions.en:
### Notes

- This operation is available only for Data Warehouse Edition clusters in elastic mode that have 32 cores or more.

- The default resource group USER\_DEFAULT does not support attaching database accounts.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb bind-db-resource-pool-with-user --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --pool-name test --pool-user accout --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-t72410000 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb BindDBResourcePoolWithUser --region cn-hangzhou --PoolUser accout --PoolName test --DBClusterId 'am-bp1ub9grke10000' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-t72410000'
